- Потокобезопасное in-memory хранилище.

5. Заверши работу, указав изменённые файлы и фактические результаты тестирования.

// Link представляет сокращённую ссылку и её статистику.
type Link struct {

	Hits      int64     `json:"hits"`

Code generation details:
```go
const codeAlphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
const codeLength = 6

func generateCode() (string, error) {
	b := make([]byte, codeLength)
	if _, err := rand.Read(b); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = codeAlphabet[int(b[i])%len(codeAlphabet)]
	}
	return string(b), nil
}
```
Modulo bias is negligible here; no problem.

Create in the store: loop: generate code, lock, check existence, insert. To avoid holding the lock across the loop... the simplest approach:
```go
func (s *LinkStore) Create(url string) (*Link, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
		code, err := generateCode()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, exists := s.links[code]; exists {
			continue
		}
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		link := &Link{Code: code, URL: url, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
		s.links[code] = link
		return link, nil
	}
	return nil, errCodeCollision
}
```

## Requirements
- POST /api/links creates a short link; GET /{code} redirects to the original URL; GET /api/links/{code}/stats returns transition statistics.
- Thread-safe in-memory storage; standard-library Go only.
- Preserve /health behavior and all existing tests; do not modify README.md; do not delete existing tests.
- Re-run `go test -race ./...` with `CGO_ENABLED=1` using `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\gcc.exe` (GCC 16.2.0 via MSYS2 UCRT64, user-provided); independently fix any errors and re-verify; also run `go vet ./...`.
- Final report must separately show: (a) results of the initial autonomous run, and (b) results of the additional verification after the environment change. User communicates in Russian — write the final report in Russian.

## Decisions
- `store.go`: thread-safe `LinkStore` (`sync.RWMutex`), random base62 6-char codes via `crypto/rand` with collision retry (≤32 tries); `Create`/`Get`/`RecordHit`/`Snapshot` (copy).
- `handlers.go`: `createLinkHandler` (201 `{code,url,short_url}`; 400 bad URL; 405 wrong method), `redirectHandler` (302 + hit increment; 404 unknown), `statsHandler` (JSON snapshot; 405 wrong method); `writeJSON`/`writeErrorJSON`.
- `main.go`: `newAppMux(store)` registers all routes; health registered as `"GET /health"` (the conflict fix).
- Race-test invocation (fresh shell per command, so env vars must be set inline): `$env:CC="C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\gcc.exe"; $env:CGO_ENABLED="1"; & "C:\Program Files\Go\bin\go.exe" test -race -v ./...`
- For gcc diagnostics, use batch files run via `cmd /c` instead of direct PowerShell calls: PowerShell 5.1 native-command stderr handling garbles/swallows gcc's error output (encoding + ErrorRecord quirk), making diagnosis unreliable.
- Working hypothesis for the cgo failure (reinforced, unconfirmed): Go's cgo tool shortens paths to 8.3 form on Windows (evidence: `gcc -v` shows cc1 invoked with `C:\Users\REMOTE~1\AppData\Local\Temp\...`); if gcc.exe/cc1.exe are MSYS2-runtime binaries (msys-2.0.dll), their Windows→POSIX argument conversion turns the 8.3 short name into a nonexistent POSIX path (`/c/Users/REMOTE~1/...`), so cc1 silently fails. Disambiguation pending (gcc_test3.bat).
- gcc fails with exit 1 and zero output on ANY compile (plain, `-std=gnu90/99/11`, and the full cgo-like flag set), and no `.o` file is ever produced — so the `-std=gnu90` theory is ruled out.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full implementation done: created `store.go`, `handlers.go`, `links_test.go`; edited `main.go` (store wiring + `"GET /health"` registration).
- Mux panic resolved (`"GET /health"` instead of `"/health"`); `TestCreateLink` short_url scheme bug fixed via `requestScheme(r)` helper.

- `go build -race -x .` captured the exact cgo step: compiles `C:\Program Files\Go\src\runtime\cgo\cgo.go` via gcc with `-O2 -g -Wall -Werror -fno-stack-protector -Wdeclaration-after-statement -std=gnu90`; WORK dir was `C:\Users\REMOTE~1\AppData\Local\Temp\go-build2474363176` (8.3 short form).

- `gcc_test3.bat` created (cc1.exe direct invocation with long vs 8.3 short path + `objdump -p` DLL-dependency listing for gcc.exe and cc1.exe) — written but NOT yet run.
